sql: SELECT n.id,e.id,JSON_EXTRACT(n.props,'$.archetype') FROM (SELECT e.* FROM anchors e WHERE e.dst='bd2c011c-cdc2-53f2-b10c-69bb686cea74' AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND (e.arch_type='Knows' OR e.arch_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor='Knows')) AND (e.src_type IS NULL OR e.src_type='Person' OR e.src_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor='Person')) UNION ALL SELECT e.* FROM anchors e WHERE e.src='bd2c011c-cdc2-53f2-b10c-69bb686cea74' AND e.undirected=1 AND e.src<>e.dst AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND (e.arch_type='Knows' OR e.arch_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor='Knows')) AND (e.dst_type IS NULL OR e.dst_type='Person' OR e.dst_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor='Person'))) e JOIN anchors n ON n.id=CASE WHEN e.src='bd2c011c-cdc2-53f2-b10c-69bb686cea74' THEN e.dst ELSE e.src END AND n.kind='NodeAnchor' AND (n.arch_type='Person' OR n.arch_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor='Person')) ORDER BY e.seq,e.id
name: statement/sql/select
